title: Symbol Anatomy
slide_intent: Show which shapes create the symbol’s contrasting character. Viewers can read efficiency and softness in the same form.
strategic_value: Instacart can carry the straight-versus-curved distinction into other shapes and letters.
demonstration: Construction marks pick out a straight segment and a rounded end on the pale green arrow above the pale orange root.
practical_value: Use straight edges and rounded ends from the symbol as a reference when designing a related shape.
